items.text: Yami muntu namoni ihuŋu namutondu windi wakuzuwa.
Nanlomboli nakuŋendesha mumwidima, mwakadi chejeji.
Chalala kwaamu, yami abalumwinaŋayi chikasa chindi hanti nahanti mwaana wejima.
Nanyikwishi dehi ikowadami ninyisunyi yami, nakotoli dehi mafwahami.
Nantuŋili dehi, naninyeŋumwishi dehi nawulembi nakukabakana.
Nanshakamishi mwiyila bwi-i, neyi antu afwili dehi chachikulu.
Nankolekeli dehi ikoli kwi-ndo kulonda nikaŋanyi kwidika. Nanlemesheli dehi ileŋi dami.
Mwalala chinukukaloka nyiteti nakutambika nami ankwashuku, yena hakwenzelela kulombela kwami hanzi.
Kunjila jami yena nakolekuku ikoli damalola akubalula, naheŋeshi dehi njila jami.
Kudami yena nekali dehi neyi bera wudi nakubelamina, neyi mutupa wawutamaŋa kumbeŋu kumbeŋu.
Nanteŋulwili dehi njila jami, nansansoli dehi sansu sansu; nankonki dehi.
Nevuli dehi wuta windi, naŋimiki dehi niikali chuma chakwasaŋa muvu windi.
Nyivu yamungongu windi nayiŋŋi dehi munyijiŋwa yami.
Yami akusehawu kudi antaŋa jami ejima; yami akwimbaŋawu namutumina twawu mwaana wejima.
Naŋikutishi dehi yalula, nanwishi dehi mutondu walula ivumu mbe.
Nankotoli dehi maji ami nankalawanda, nambuti dehi namawuti wi-i.
Wunaŋumbili dehi kwakulehi nakuwunda. Navulameneni yayiwahi.
Nelili nami, NiŊovu yami niyinatalilaŋa kudi Yehova yinanoŋi dehi kwayu.
Anukaku yihuŋu yami, nichinukulumbwaŋila, nimutondu walulaniwulembi.
Muchima wami wuchidi kwanukamu nihanu, hiwukunoŋama mukachi kami.
Muchima wami chiwukutoŋojokamu hinukukuhwelela.
Chanabuli kutunuŋununawu lwoluwi lwambala lwaYehova lwavula, niwushona windi wabulaŋa kukuma.
Wabalumukaŋa kwawu wawiha habudidi habudidi; kashinshi keyi kasweja.
Muchima wami nindi, Yehova diyi iseka dami, dichi chinukumukuhwelela.
Amumonaŋa Yehova kuwaha wowu amuchiŋililaŋa, nimuchima wamukeŋakeŋaŋa.
Kukuhwelela wamwinu waYehova nakudiwunjikilamu zo-o chachiwahi.
Chawaha muntu kusenda mpanda hawansi windi.
Ashakami kwindi kanka windi nakudimwenena zo-o, muloŋa anamutwikiyi kudi yena.
Anoŋami kwindi heseki, wamba kela kukwikala kukuhwelela.
Atalishi ikidi dindi kudi mukwawu wukumweta; ekuti kusawuka.
Muloŋa Mwanta hakomba muntu chahaya nyakaku.
Hela wukumwesha muntu kukala, wakamutiyila wushona mwashikila luwi lwindi lwasweja.
Muloŋa yena hakeŋa kukabisha muntu, hela kumwesha anyana kawantu kukalaku.
Kudatola ahanu heseki akasewa ejima nakuyichika,
kuteŋulula kuloŋa kwamuntu kumesu aMukwakubadika,
kuheŋesha muloŋa wamuntu, yumiyi Mwanta hayikeŋaku.
Hinyi wukuhosha chuma chakadi kumuleja kudi Mwanta, chimwekana?
Mukanwa kaMukwakubadika himwafumaŋa niyatama niyayiwahuku, tahindi?
Muntu wamumi atatokaŋa tuhu, muntu atatoki nachakumubabeshawu nanshidi jindi.
Tukeŋakeŋenu njila jetu, tutalenu mujinayi, tufuntenu kudi Yehova.
Tutalishenu nyichima yetu nimakasetu hamu kudi Nzambi mwiwulu.
Tunaputoli, tunadikaŋi, eyi kweyi kutwanakena nehi.
Wunatubuti kuzuwa, wunatuhaŋi; wunatujahi, nikutiya luwi nehi.
Wunadibuti ivu kulonda kulomba kwetu kubuli kuhanuka.
Wunatubalumuni dehi neyi nkaku nanswadi mukachi kanyuza yawantu.
Ayilumbu jetu ejima anatwasamini mukanwa.
Niwoma niikela yinatuwani, nikutukonka nikujilumuka nawa.
Mesu ami apolomokaŋa kwatuloŋa twameji nakujilumuka kunajilumuki mwana kawantaŋa jami wamumbanda.
Mesu ami apolomokaŋa hohu, hiyamwenaŋaku, hiyanookeshaŋaku,
nichamba kelayi Yehova wudi mwiwulu hakutala mwishina, hakumona.
Mesu ami aneyilishi dehi muchima wami, nansaŋu yawanyana awambanda ejima ahamukala wami.
Awa aneli ayilumbu jami chakadi muloŋa, ananhaŋi nankashi neyi kajila.
Anaketwili wumi wami mukaleya kamuwina, ombilahu niilola.
Meji anhita nihanamutu wi-i, nami, Nafwi dehi.
Mukaleya kamuwina kakuma kwishina chikupu, natambikili ijina deyi, eyi Yehova.
Eyi watiyili izu dami; chinukwonashana nakudila bayi wubuta kwitu deyuku.
Wakundamini kwakwihi ifuku dinakutambikili, welili neyi, Bayi wutiya womaku.
Eyi Mwanta, wunanhakwili nyiloŋa yami, wunakuuli wumi wami.
Eyi Yehova, wunamoni chanankoŋuwu chatama, sompeshaku muloŋa wami.
Wunamoni kutenda kwawu kwejima niyuma yanankasakasiluwu yejima.
Eyi Yehova, wunatiyi chanansawuluwu, niyuma yakunkasakasilawu yejima;
nyivumbu yanawa annyamukilili, nimwadiŋi nakunfuukwilawu mwaana wejima.
Talaku nichakushakamawu nichakwimanawu, yami kamina kawu.
Eyi Yehova wakayinka wufwetu wawu mwashikila nyidimu yakumakasawu.
Wakayinka nyichima yachinchika, dodishiŋu diwakayishiŋa.
Wakayikupisha nakuzuwa, wakayijilumuna mwishina damawulu aYehova.
